<!-- The faq page of ThemeSupportCenterScreen. -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FaqList, PageIntro, tpl, uniqLabel, type Faq, type FaqTab } from "@ui8kit/vue-ui";
import { fromCodex } from "@ui8kit/app-shared/runtime/core";
import { ui } from "@ui8kit/app-shared/content";
import { faq as faqEntries } from "@ui8kit/app-shared/data/faq";
import { faqtabs as faqtabsEntries } from "@ui8kit/app-shared/data/faqtabs";

const FAQ_FIELDS = {"id":"id","question":"title.en","answer":"metadata.answer.value","category":"metadata.category.value"} as const;
const FAQTABS_FIELDS = {"id":"id","title":"title.en","value":"metadata.value.value"} as const;

const faq = fromCodex<Faq>(faqEntries, FAQ_FIELDS);
const faqtabs = fromCodex<FaqTab>(faqtabsEntries, FAQTABS_FIELDS);
</script>

<template>
  <PageIntro
    id="faq-pagehead"
    :title="ui.pages.supportCenter.faq.title"
    :text="ui.pages.supportCenter.faq.text"
    :cta="ui.pages.supportCenter.faq.cta"
    href="#/contact"
    align="start"
    tone="default"
    density="default"
  />
  <FaqList
    id="faq-faq-1"
    :title="ui.site.pricing.faqTitle"
    :items="faq"
    :search="{ label: ui.vibe.faq.search, query: '', mode: 'none' }"
    :filter="{ tabs: faqtabs, label: ui.vibe.faq.tabs, category: '', mode: 'none' }"
    layout="chat"
    cols="1"
    tone="default"
    density="default"
    :landmarkLabel="uniqLabel(tpl(ui.blocks.landmark, ui.blocks.names.faq, ui.blocks.variants.faq.chat))"
  />
  <FaqList
    id="faq-faq-2"
    :title="ui.site.pricing.faqTitle"
    :items="faq"
    :search="{ label: ui.vibe.faq.search, query: '', mode: 'field' }"
    :filter="{ tabs: faqtabs, label: ui.vibe.faq.tabs, category: '', mode: 'none' }"
    layout="accordion"
    cols="1"
    tone="default"
    density="default"
    :landmarkLabel="uniqLabel(tpl(ui.blocks.landmark, ui.blocks.names.faq, ui.blocks.variants.faq.search))"
  />
</template>
